unitOfAnalysis: one complete interviewer-or-constituent question and corresponding politician response

DIRECT_ANSWER.rule: materially answers the question asked rather than merely repeating the subject

PARTIAL_ANSWER.rule: addresses some but not all salient components

PIVOT.rule: moves to a substantially different preferred topic without answering

EXPLICIT_REFUSAL.rule: states an unwillingness to answer; separate justified legal constraints

ACKNOWLEDGED_UNCERTAINTY.rule: openly states limits of present knowledge and whether/how answer will be supplied

REPETITIVE_SLOGAN.rule: same phrasing repeated verbatim in unrelated Q/A units; require comparison examples

SOURCE_VERIFIED_CONTRADICTION.rule: two otherwise comparable statements genuinely conflict; requires two primary sources and temporal context

COMPARISON_WITHOUT_RELEVANCE.rule: invokes different actor/event without answering original causal or normative question

VERIFIABLE_COMMITMENT.rule: concrete authority/action/delivery milestone that can be checked later

QUESTION_ATTACK.rule: attacks interviewer or premise rather than addressing evidence

procedure.sampling: stratify by party, chamber, medium, topic, calendar period, and question difficulty; retain full context; include null and counterexamples
procedure.blinding: coders blind to candidate identity when feasible; provenance preserved separately
procedure.doubleCoding: all pilot units plus random 25% full sample
procedure.reliability: Krippendorff alpha per nominal variable; report category-specific estimates and uncertainty
procedure.underperformingCategories: revise coding instructions, recode and disclose initial disagreement; do not silently discard
